**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (draft PR reviewed anyway; marked ready on a clean review).

**What looks good**
- Posting is closed on every path I could find. Both engine call sites (`posting.rs:343` single post, `posting_per_op.rs:100` per-op) sit behind `verification_report`, which now carries `inverted_post_refusal()` (`posting.rs:516`). The script API `verify`/`check` and the MCP job findings read the same report. The only other `engine::run` is `commands/post.rs:36` (empty stream, no machine) and the CLI, which now refuses. No setup-sheet or other path posts coordinates.
- Travel mapping is right both ways: `machine/mod.rs:310` judges `(w - origin) * sign` against the machine's own `[lo, hi]`, and the message says "(inverted axis)". `program_travel` maps `[lo,hi]` to `[-hi,-lo]`. The asymmetric X -10..300 case is pinned (`the_table_box_maps_an_inverted_stroke`: -300..10).
- Table box flip (`fixture.rs:105`) is consistent with the old semantics (Z top = program-frame low end).
- A standard axis writes no key, so shipped machines, saved projects and the post mirror are byte-identical. I ran all 11 `assets/machines/*.mch` (including `3axis-vmc.mch`, which is not in `posting::MACHINES`) through the new CLI door: all accepted, rc 0.
- Garbled directions refuse by name (not read as standard); the editor goes through `EditMachineApply` -> `LoadMachine` (undoable); no unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code; plain labels; provenance on the new module; docs/decision file present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #373`; no CHANGELOG.md edit; no build.rs/.github/scripts/deps changes.

**Local results** (trial merge with current origin/main: already up to date, no conflicts; debug)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| app axis_direction | 11 passed |
| app machine | 32 passed |
| app tormach_machines | 5 passed |
| app posting | 17 passed |
| app conformance | 6 passed |
| app golden_cl | 23 passed |
| app fanuc_post | 8 passed |
| app project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| app fixtures | 14 passed |
| app setup_sheet | 7 passed |
| camcraft-post (all suites, incl. axis_direction_cli) | green (1, 9, 33 + 0-test targets) |
| camcraft-ui --lib (CWD crates/ui) | 297 passed, 2 ignored |
| clippy -D warnings, post + app + ui, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `AxisDirection`'s serde accepts `-1` on a rotary axis in a project file, while `parse_mch` refuses it; `inverted_axes()` ignores rotaries, so it is harmless today (a hand-edited project only). Refusing it on load would close the asymmetry.
2. The CLI now refuses any `--machine` file `parse_mch` rejects, which is stricter than the old `from_json` alone. All shipped files pass; a hand-written file the app already refuses will now also be refused by the CLI, which is intended.
3. `posting.rs` is 1049 lines (+2 here); already over the 400 guideline, flagged only.
4. Not exercised: the editor combo by hand (GUI not launched), and actual posting for inverted axes (#374).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
